# KnowFate

> KnowFate (Chinese name 觀命 / 观命) is an honest BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny, 八字) site: deterministic chart calculation plus a plain-language knowledge library of Day Masters, Ten Gods, the Five Elements, symbolic stars and the 60 day pillars. No predictions, no fortune-telling, no remedies to sell.

## Method

- Charts are computed by a deterministic engine, not a language model: True Solar Time correction, a 23:00 day boundary, month pillars set by solar terms. The same birth data always yields the same chart.
- Favorable/unfavorable elements (喜忌) come from a fixed rule engine (support-and-suppress plus climate adjustment, with special patterns left open rather than guessed).
- Symbolic stars (神煞) are looked up from a fixed list of 20, single-sourced from Sanming Tonghui (《三命通会》).
- A language model only phrases the wording of interpretations; it never judges chart outcomes, and hard "structure" classifications are deliberately avoided.
- English-Chinese terminology is anchored to one translation table shared with the app and this site's glossary.
- Content is for entertainment and self-reflection only.

## Library overviews

- [The BaZi Library (all terms)](https://knowfate.app/en/library): index of every term explained on the site
- [Day Masters overview](https://knowfate.app/en/library): the ten Day Masters (Jia Wood through Gui Water)
- [Ten Gods overview](https://knowfate.app/en/library): the ten relationship types read against the Day Master
- [Five Elements overview](https://knowfate.app/en/library): Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water and their generating/overcoming cycle
- [About and method](https://knowfate.app/en/about): how charts are cast and read
- [BaZi calculator](https://knowfate.app/en/bazi-calculator): free four-pillars chart with True Solar Time

## Traditional Chinese pages

The full library is also published in Traditional Chinese: [觀命知識庫](https://knowfate.app/zh-hant/library).
